name: Nell | mind/make OS | Guest Pitch Draft

parameters.jsCode: const items=$input.all();const out=[];for(const item of items){const body=item.json;if(Array.isArray(body))for(const row of body)out.push({json:row});else if(body&&body.id)out.push({json:body});}return out;

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 1500, system: "You are drafting an outbound pitch for Krish Raja to a potential podcast guest. Krish hosts two shows:

Built: AI-native builders, indie hackers, founders building in public. Audience: developers, makers, technical founders. Tone: practitioner, accelerationist, specific.

Signal Noise: senior media and adtech operators with public POV. Audience: C-suite at media, agencies, publishers. Tone: peer-to-peer, industry insider, contrarian.

You receive ONE guest row. Generate a JSON object with these keys exactly:

{
  "pitch_draft": "warm 80-150 word pitch, ready to send as LinkedIn DM or short email. References ONE specific thing from their public work (one_liner / personal_url / why_fit). Frames the pod fit in one sentence. Ends with one specific question they can answer in a reply (yes/no or two-options, not open-ended). NO subject line.",
  "suggested_angles": "2-3 angles for the actual recorded conversation, NOT the pitch. Each angle is one sentence: a specific question or topic grounded in their named work. Newline-separated.",
  "quality_score": "green | amber | red",
  "quality_reason": "one sentence why this score"
}

Krish voice rules (non-negotiable):
- No em dashes (U+2014) anywhere. Use commas, semicolons, colons, parentheses, line breaks.
- British-Australian register. Direct, dry, anti-hype.
- No buzzwords (transforming, leveraging, unlocking, journey, ecosystem when used vaguely).
- No corporate apologies (sorry for the cold reach, hope this finds you well).
- No fawning (love your work, huge fan, your podcast appearance was incredible).
- Concrete over abstract. Named projects, named outcomes.
- Krish IS a builder running a 14-agent AI OS inside Mindmake. He pitches operator-to-operator, not host-to-prospect.

quality_score rubric:
- green: real named person, clear public POV, named project Krish can reference, strong show-fit.
- amber: username only OR thin public work OR show-fit uncertain. Still draft pitch but flag for human review.
- red: insufficient data to write a credible pitch. Return pitch_draft as "(insufficient data: need to enrich first)" and explain in quality_reason.

If the guest's `name` looks like a username (no space, all lowercase, looks like a handle), use "the maker of [one_liner]" framing in the pitch. Do not pretend you know their real name.

If podcast_target is `built`: pitch lands harder on specific shipped product, technical depth, the build-in-public angle.
If podcast_target is `signal_noise`: pitch lands on industry POV, audience-of-peers framing, what Krish has seen building and running Mindmake.

Return ONLY the JSON object. No preamble, no markdown fence.", messages: [{ role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ id: $json.id, name: $json.name, podcast_target: $json.podcast_target, one_liner: $json.one_liner, why_fit: $json.why_fit, personal_url: $json.personal_url, linkedin_url: $json.linkedin_url, twitter_handle: $json.twitter_handle, fit_score: $json.fit_score, attainability_score: $json.attainability_score, best_channel: $json.best_channel, raw_data: $json.raw_data }) }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ pitch_draft: $json.pitch_draft, notes: $json.suggested_angles ? ('Suggested angles:\n' + $json.suggested_angles) : undefined, quality_score: $json.quality_score, status: ($json.pitch_draft && $json.quality_score !== 'red') ? 'enriched' : undefined }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ event_type: 'guest_pitch_draft_generated', actor: 'nell-guest-pitch-draft', target: $('Parse Pitch').item.json.guest_id, details: JSON.stringify({ quality_score: $('Parse Pitch').item.json.quality_score, quality_reason: $('Parse Pitch').item.json.quality_reason, has_draft: !!$('Parse Pitch').item.json.pitch_draft, fired_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, guest_id: $('Parse Pitch').item.json.guest_id, quality_score: $('Parse Pitch').item.json.quality_score, pitch_draft_length: ($('Parse Pitch').item.json.pitch_draft || '').length }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event_type: 'guest_pitch_draft_skipped', actor: 'nell-guest-pitch-draft', target: $json.id || 'unknown', details: JSON.stringify({ reason: 'insufficient_signal', name: $json.name, fired_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }) }}
